package probe
func Calc(x bool) bool { return !x }
public class Probe {private Probe(){} public static boolean calc(boolean x){return !x;}}
pub fn calc(x:bool)->bool{!x}
export function calc(x:boolean):boolean{return !x;}

package probe
func Calc(x int) int {total:=0;for i:=0;i<x;i++{total+=i*i};return total}
public class Probe {private Probe(){} public static int calc(int x){int total=0;for(int i=0;i<x;i++){total+=i*i;}return total;}}
pub fn calc(x:i32)->i32{let mut total=0i32;let mut i=0i32;while i<x{total=total.wrapping_add(i.wrapping_mul(i));i=i.wrapping_add(1);}total}
export function calc(x:number):number{let total=0;for(let i=0;i<x;i++){total+=i*i;}return total;}

cases.notes: One canonical recurrence and one X; no loop unrolling. Native arithmetic modes remain distinct evidence, with equal category credit.

package probe
func Calc(mode bool,x int)int{if mode{return x+1};return x*2}
public class Probe {private Probe(){} public static int calc(boolean mode,int x){return mode?x+1:x*2;}}
pub fn calc(mode:bool,x:i32)->i32{if mode{x.wrapping_add(1)}else{x.wrapping_mul(2)}}
export function calc(mode:boolean,x:number){return mode?x+1:x*2;}

package probe
func Encode(value bool)int{if value{return 1};return 0}
public class Probe {private Probe(){} public static int encode(boolean value){return value?1:0;}}
pub fn encode(value:bool)->i32{if value{1}else{0}}
export function encode(value:boolean){return value?1:0;}
public class Probe {private Probe(){} public static int calc(int x,boolean mode){return mode?x+1:x*2;} public static int calc(int x){return calc(x,false);}}
fn core(x:i32,mode:bool)->i32{if mode{x.wrapping_add(1)}else{x.wrapping_mul(2)}} pub fn configured(x:i32,mode:bool)->i32{core(x,mode)} pub fn default(x:i32)->i32{core(x,false)}
